comparison.objective: Install a circlip in a shaft groove; candidate extracts one electrical terminal from a housing.
comparison.physical_skill: Circlip spreading, groove seating and rotation versus wire deflection, recessed single-blade insertion and coordinated withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Ring seated without over-spread/twist and pliers released versus selected terminal removed with housing, crimp and neighbors intact. Candidate force/damage thresholds are not yet numeric.
comparison.reason: Opposite assembly state and different tool-contact mechanics; generic tool alignment does not establish overlap.
